_comment: Timed on-screen messages for clip.html. Each key is a YouTube video ID — the 11 characters after v= in the address. 't' is seconds into the video (absolute, not relative to the clip start); each line stays up until the next one. Use 'text' for plain lines, or 'html' for styled ones: <span class=flash> pulses, <span class=big> enlarges, <span class=pos> is the bright closing colour. The key must match the ?v= value in the OptiSigns asset URL.
